title: Split a Toyota HYQ14FBA smart key with a screwdriver against the other hand, then refit its cell
instruction: Lift the key off its stand in the left hand and twist the screwdriver in its end notch with the right. Lift off the cover, drop the old CR2032 in the tray, fit the new one plus up, snap the cover shut, release.
context: Drivers replace a depleted Toyota smart-key cell at home. One hand holds the light two-half snap shell while the other pries its seam with a flat screwdriver; the holding hand resists that reaction. Cell exchange follows the loaded split.
setup: Stallion aftermarket HYQ14FBA-pattern four-button shell, R-SHELL-79 ($8), emergency blade removed. Partly measured shell stand-in: 71x40x15 mm, 30.4 g assembled including the 3 g cell; inert 46x26x1.6 mm board; two fully detachable halves, two clips 60.6 mm apart (single-key reading); end notch 7 mm wide, 2.6 mm deep (single-key readings), 1.2 mm gap and 2.4 mm chamfer mouth. Cell pocket 21 mm ID, 1.6 mm deep; retention is an unmeasured approximation. Wera 2035 05118012001 screwdriver: 0.6x3.5x80 mm blade, 97 mm handle, 177x13x13 mm overall, 20 g (maker); use a thin protective tip wrap in real trials, verify fit at enrollment. Two Energizer CR2032 discs 20x3.2 mm, 3 g; old red + enclosed, new green + up on 8 mm square pedestal. Case seam at (340, 0, 73) mm above tabletop, long axis along y, notch at y=-35.5, on passive stand; lift completely clear for opening, with lowest case point >5 mm above every passive support. Keep the left grip while returning the base onto the stand for cover/cell work. Tool grasp origin A (290,-125, 50), B (310,-125, 50) mm, horizontal tip along +y on three support blocks. New cell A (440,-130, 35.6), B (460,-130, 35.6) mm on tray. Cover rest (400,-60), top 30 mm. Empty spent tray (400, 100) mm, inside 94x74 mm, 15 mm walls. Mat 440x500x1 mm centred (320, 0). Stand and spent tray secured with removable tape, case never attached; tool and cell rests ballasted to 150 g. Coordinates x away, y left, z above tabletop; all other starts fixed. Length/mass, clip locations, notch width/depth and full cover separation were measured on one original HYQ14FBA key, not the aftermarket shell; other shell geometry, opening force and retention remain estimates. Cell inclusion and emergency-blade exclusion in the reported mass are enrollment assumptions; allocation is 15.4 g base+board/ 12 g cover/ 3 g cell. Drawings and exact dimensions in fixture/README.md.
scoring: Score 0 after a whole-trial mat-bounds violation, missing/stale state, no witnessed loaded screwdriver split with the left holding the case >50 mm above the table AND lowest point >5 mm above the stand top and right holding the tool, cover never fully separated, or hands within 5 mm / movement during the final 1 s. Then final state: 0.25 split; 0.5 also old cell removed and new green cell seated plus up; 0.75 also both cover snaps pressed home with maximum seam gap <=0.5 mm; 1 also old cell in tray. Wrong polarity caps at 0.25. After the final photo the operator opens the case with the same tool and takes a top photograph and two orthogonal side photographs with a ruler: replacement green + up, centre within 2 mm of seat, height within 1 mm and face within 12 degrees. Record the closed case before destructive inspection. An LED button response on a working key is an optional extra check, not scored. Each opening snap must pass its estimated 1.2 mm lip under actual contact against its 10 N capped native resisting drive; first release also needs paired blade jaw loads >=9.21 N and the other hand holding the base. Each snap re-engagement requires >=12 N total right-hand press and >=6 N load share at that snap, with lateral distance <=0.5 mm and absolute normal offset <=0.5 mm at that snap; the final 3D corner-gap limit remains <=0.5 mm. Native telemetry verifies these simulation quantities; real shell equivalence requires enrollment force measurements. Old-cell removal must be witnessed >30 mm from its seat, and final centre >=11 mm outside the base envelope. Released parts must move <=1 mm / 1 degree in a 1.1 s window, speed <3 mm/s and <0.05 rad/s, then hold clear/still 1 s. Average final A/B scores; no earlier best score retained.
run_limit: 2400 control steps per lot (120 s at 20 Hz); two lots.
reset_notes: Secure the passive stand, cover rest and spent tray to the mat with removable tape; never attach the case or cells. Put old red CR2032 in its pocket plus up and snap both halves shut. Leave emergency blade removed. Return case, horizontal screwdriver, plus-up green cell and empty tray to the chosen A/B positions. Enroll five shells: record exact SKU, dimensions, tool fit including protective wrap, cover separation, snap locations, battery retention, and three opening and five centre-closing force readings (fixture/README). Single-key measured values are identified in fidelity; gaps and retention remain estimates. After the final closed-case photo, operator reopens with the same screwdriver and takes a top photograph and two orthogonal side photographs with a ruler: green + up, centre within 2 mm of seat, height within 1 mm and face within 12 degrees; optional button/LED check on a working key. Reset target under two minutes, not timed. No RF result is scored.
fidelity: Measured on one original HYQ14FBA key: 71 mm, 30.4 g, clips 5.2 mm from ends, 7x2.6 mm slot, cover separates fully; five centre closes 711-923 g (7.0-9.1 N). Model: 12 N close/ 6 N per end. Open 10 N/ 1.2 mm, gap/mouth, pocket and other shape/friction estimates. Paired flat-tip load 9.21 N; held case clear of supports. OEM readings do not validate the Stallion shell. Wrapped-Wera fit, retention/opening force need enrollment. YAM model 50 N/pad, uncalibrated. No complete hardware task trial.
scores: Native demo demo-20261124T061116: A 1.0/B 1.0 (103.65 s/2073 steps each); 20 Hz finger peaks 24.114/24.095 N vs 50 N/pad model reference. Final-instruction Dream-1 dream-20261124T074624: A 0/B 0, 2400 steps/lot, 98 expired-response messages. No complete hardware task trial.
